title: MRemoteng HTTPS not autofilling defined  username or password
author: sibusiso-dhludhlu
body_snippet: MRemoteng HTTPS not autofilling defined  username or password

comments.author: cremenescu
comments.snippet:
The HTTP and HTTPS protocols don't use the connection's Username and Password, and 1.76 didn't either: the code that would have sent them as an `Authorization: Basic` header was already commented out there. So this is a missing feature rather than a regression.

What could be added is answering the site's own sign-in prompt (HTTP Basic authentication) with those credentials, through WebView2's `BasicAuthenticationRequested` event. Filling in a login form on a web page can't be done reliably in g...
